items.summary: On September 3, Mama’s Creations (NASDAQ:MAMA) reported second quarter fiscal 2027 results that turned a familiar growth story into something sturdier. items.title: Consumers are already on their holiday shopping grind, set to outspend 2025
items.summary: Even though back-to-school shopping just wrapped, consumers may already be checking off holiday wishlists in September, according to a new Accenture survey. Accenture Global consumer goods, retail, and travel lead Kath Gramling comments on how early shoppers may already be on track to outspend 2025 as they attempt to "win the holiday" for their families.
